verdict.rationale: Edge0 lists first-party graphical apps on several platforms: an on-device iPhone app, an Android app, a Windows desktop app and a macOS desktop app. These plausibly provide a GUI for local models, but the evidence never says they include a chat interface. The documented chat paths are a CLI one-shot chat and an OpenAI-compatible server, and neither is a built-in graphical chat UI. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the desktop/mobile apps offer a chat UI, description of chat features (history, streaming, model selection), screenshots or hands-on corroboration.
